reason: The 'no effect' conclusion rests on one post-hoc choice of the north-region subsample (estimate 0.543, SE 0.382, p=0.15), which the report does not justify and which is not robust: the full sample with the same controls gives 0.053 (SE 0.233), while the unadjusted association is 1.78 (p<0.001), and the other regions give different signs and sizes. Non-significance in one subsample with a CI of roughly [-0.2, 1.3] does not establish 'no effect', and the report omits these sensitivity results.
